Connecting to Your VPS via Windows Remote Desktop

How to remote into your Vincere VPS from any computer: enter the IP, save your QuantVPS credentials once, and land on the desktop where Ninja Trader lives. Takes about a minute.

Source video: Loom walkthrough

  1. 1

    Open Remote Desktop Connection

    0:28

    The remote connection is how you get into your VPS. On a PC you use the built-in Remote Desktop Connection app.

    1. On your PC, find the search bar at the bottom of your screen (next to the Start button) and type remote.
    2. Open Remote Desktop Connection from the results.
    3. On a Mac or iPhone, use the Windows App instead — see the separate Mac connection procedure (link coming soon).

    The demo VPS desktop; on a PC, launch Remote Desktop Connection from Start menu search.

  2. 2

    Enter your VPS IP address

    0:40

    The IP address identifies your specific VPS. It is listed under your QuantVPS account on their website.

    1. Type your VPS IP address into the Computer field.
    2. To find your credentials: log in at quantvps.com, click Sign On (top right), then click Manage on the next screen.
    3. The credentials are listed below on that page; click the eye icon to reveal the password.

    Remote Desktop Connection: your VPS IP goes in the Computer field (redacted here).

  3. 3

    Click Show Options and enter the username

    0:43

    Show Options exposes the username field and the option to save credentials so you do not have to re-enter them every time.

    1. Click Show Options.
    2. Enter the username for your VPS (from QuantVPS).
    3. Recommended: check Allow me to save credentials; once you do it, you do not have to do it again.

    Show Options expanded: username field plus Allow me to save credentials.

  4. 4

    Save the connection as a shortcut

    Saving the connection creates a shortcut file that takes you right back to this point, credentials and all, so you never have to re-enter the IP or username.

    1. Still under the connection settings (Show Options), click Save As.
    2. Save the file somewhere easy to find, like your Desktop.
    3. Next time, just double-click that shortcut to jump straight to the connection.
  5. 5

    Connect and enter the password

    0:56

    Windows Security prompts for the VPS password on connect.

    1. Click Connect.
    2. Enter the password for your VPS (from QuantVPS).
    3. Recommended: check Remember me, same reasoning as saving the username.

    Windows Security prompt: enter the VPS password; Remember me is recommended.

  6. 6

    You are in

    1:12

    Once the credentials are accepted, Remote Desktop drops you onto the VPS desktop, where Ninja Trader and the trading tools live.

    1. Confirm you can see the VPS desktop with the Ninja Trader shortcut.
    2. You are now ready for the Ninja Trader startup process.

    Connected: the VPS desktop with Ninja Trader ready to go.

Key facts

CredentialsVPS IP, username, and password: log in at quantvps.com, Sign On (top right), then Manage; credentials are listed below, eye icon reveals the password.
Mac / iPhoneUse the Windows App; see the separate Mac connection procedure (link coming soon).
Save loginsSaving the username and password is recommended so you only enter them once.
